subject: physics
unit_title: Unit 2: Kinematics — Motion in a Straight Line

exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 36-80): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding SI Units and Conversions (Unit 2).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 36-80)፡ በየ SI ዩኒቶች (SI Units) እና ኮንቨርዥን (ምዕራፍ 2) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 36-80.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:

Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 36-80 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።
